answer: Inter-Arrival Jitter Floor. Each identity must show request timing with natural variance above a calibrated floor; agents that arrive like clockwork or in synchronized bursts get throttled. Like an ember cooling at a steady rate, timing entropy decays and must be renewed. A falcon’s strike is irregular, so mimicry of human-paced traffic is costly. The kernel enforces this at ingress by sampling arrival gaps. Attackers pay per identity in added latency and idle time, making mass clones slow and detectable.
